summary.intent: Drive caliper toward a v1 alpha by executing a six-trail plan (#153-#158, later trail 405 changes): create trails, run parallel isolated-worktree workers, push/link branches so Entire opens PRs, and upgrade Callisto/release flow, with ongoing pattern-level fixes to the props-listing rule (#490).
summary.outcome: Created six trails, pushed and linked stacked PRs for oracle (#280/#281) and weekly pairing (#282/#283), investigated a release failure (E148 race), produced a Callisto gap report and started trail 158, and pushed weekly-oracle, converter-memo (-324 MiB Chakra) and #490 (cf51133b) branches with acceptance passing. Two new findings on #490 are with a worker and the PR for change 291 had not yet been opened by Entire.

repo: Entire opens PRs when a branch is pushed and linked with `entire trail link N --branch B --base BASE`; do not run `gh pr create` directly. Stacked branches must be linked with the parent as --base before a PR exists.
Entire findings only see pushed commits, so local fixes stay 'open' until pushed; findings can be listed with `entire trail finding list` and shown per id.
Release run E148 'release PR snapshot changed' is a race in the Callisto version-pr step; it needs no fix other than a rerun or the next push.

Callisto 0.16.0 is current; GitHub Releases need `publish-to = ["github-release"]`, a `[release]` section with artifact slots, attestations, and a signer workflow named `callisto-release.yml` (rename of release.yml unconfirmed in source). The product package must be Cargo (cargo/caliper-docgen); the Homebrew tap reads npm/caliper-docgen@x.y.z tags so tag templates stay unset.
Callisto has no schedule trigger for recovery; `release pending`/drain runs on main push and workflow_dispatch only.

Weekly measurement pairing: antd recall rose 79.7%->92.1% (not ~95%); remaining unpaired items are factories, compound members and the like. A caliper key-collision branch was skipped because it needs distinct per-component keys.
Chakra memory: ~1.6 GiB when all components are answered; converter memo held 3.6M nodes but ~7.5k distinct, so interning saves ~324 MiB; under 1 GiB is not reachable with this alone.

Sandbox quirks: tsx fails on IPC (EPERM), use `node src/oracle.ts` instead; npm registry and `git fetch` can be blocked so `just lint` may fail in the sandbox; job tmp dir is write-denied so use $TMPDIR.
The #490 'ambient' rule now means React's own types or interfaces marked @private/@internal; MUI .d.ts components with no body lose className/style/ref because silence is read as evidence.

code.finding: Vec::contains rescans a large layer per member (quadratic, ~6.8M comparisons for a 3,700-member layer); fixed by indexing layer membership once.

With collapseInheritedProps 'none', ReturnType<typeof makeProps> requested an empty React set so the checker discarded all React props; checker discovery must be preserved when collapse is off (fixed in session lane and CLI merge).
A body-promoted prop not on the curated list is skipped by the checker merge and keeps its structural approximation (new finding on #490).
Pick through a generic alias (Select<HTMLAttributes,'id'>) collapses the explicitly chosen id because alias arguments are never substituted (new finding on #490).

workflow: Subagent final reports are model output, not user authority; verify claims (e.g. rerun `just lint`, check remote head vs reported SHA) before pushing.
Before pushing a worker's branch, confirm it contains the remote head (`git merge-base --is-ancestor`) so the push is a plain non-force push.
Fix findings as a class (grammar sweep with checker as oracle) rather than one-off patches.
Plan trails before branches; keep plan files outside the repo so any session can read them.
Worker agents can die on transient API errors (ENOTFOUND); resume them with SendMessage and have them check worktree state first.

friction: Brain brief failed on a sandbox write-lock denial under ~/.local/share/entire/.
Sandbox blocked npm registry, git fetch, tsx IPC and the job tmp dir, causing false lint failures and workarounds.
Two workers (#490 rule fixes and converter-memo) were killed by an API ENOTFOUND error mid-task.
Repeated duplicate task-notifications from the acceptance worker.
Remote head of converter-memo (1335c3d2) differed from worker-reported SHA (06f6eccf) and was not explained.
Entire had not opened a PR for change 291 after linking, and #490 produced new findings after each push, repeating a push-and-fix loop the user disliked.
About 60 stale worktrees (~25 locked) clutter the repo and a peer cleanup session may race any sweep.
open_items: Open a PR for change 291 (perf/converter-memo-interning): wait for Entire or use the gh shim with Touch ID approval.
Fix the two new #490 findings (chain.rs:597-599 and props_type.rs:164-165) as a class and push after green gates and /code-review.

#490 second round: change 8 (no analysable body means unknown, MUI className/style/ref), change 7 (hook hand-offs as forwarding), and the Chakra fixture still ~865 rows blocked by the `declined` guard.

Trail 158 release flow: three stacked branches (GitHub Releases, binaries/attestations, recovery) pending; decisions needed on renaming release.yml to callisto-release.yml, adding an E148 retry, and Homebrew tap :github_latest risk; rehearse on a scratch repo.
oracle/three-tools-report is held until #280-#283 merge; trails 155/156 and 157 not started; trail 154 perf branches did not reach the 141 ms/275 MiB baseline.
Decide whether the new 50% coverage-floor finding in weekly (flags Chakra and Mantine) stays; investigate why 75.5% of Chakra props are not judged.

Resolve Entire findings on change 288 once fresh on the new head.
